apple_owner_external_operation_leases_id.name: apple_owner_external_operation_leases_identity_check
apple_owner_external_operation_leases_id.value: ("apple_owner_external_operation_leases"."apple_subject_hash" is null and "apple_owner_external_operation_leases"."apple_principal_id" is null) or ("apple_owner_external_operation_leases"."apple_subject_hash" is not null and "apple_owner_external_operation_leases"."apple_principal_id" is not null)

origin_installation_receipt_fences_insta.name: origin_installation_receipt_fences_installation_check
origin_installation_receipt_fences_insta.value: (substr("origin_installation_receipt_fences"."installation_id",1,2)='i_' and length("origin_installation_receipt_fences"."installation_id") between 10 and 102 and substr("origin_installation_receipt_fences"."installation_id",3) not glob '*[^a-z0-9]*') or (substr("origin_installation_receipt_fences"."installation_id",1,5)='inst_' and length("origin_installation_receipt_fences"."installation_id") between 13 and 105 and substr("origin_installation_receipt_fences"."installation_id",6) not glob '*[^a-z0-9]*')

origin_possible_installations_hash_check.name: origin_possible_installations_hash_check
origin_possible_installations_hash_check.value: (("origin_possible_installations"."scope_id"='host' and "origin_possible_installations"."apple_principal_id" is null and "origin_possible_installations"."apple_subject_hash" is null) or ("origin_possible_installations"."scope_id"="origin_possible_installations"."apple_principal_id" and length("origin_possible_installations"."apple_principal_id")=43 and length("origin_possible_installations"."apple_subject_hash")=43)) and length("origin_possible_installations"."flow_token")=43

sync_workspace_epochs_epoch_check.name: sync_workspace_epochs_epoch_check
sync_workspace_epochs_epoch_check.value: length("sync_workspace_epochs"."epoch") between 16 and 64 and "sync_workspace_epochs"."epoch" not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'

workspaces_file_clock_claim_check.name: workspaces_file_clock_claim_check
workspaces_file_clock_claim_check.value: "workspaces"."file_clock_claim" is null or (length("workspaces"."file_clock_claim")=43 and "workspaces"."file_clock_claim" not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*')
